target.name: Unmodified Steam PreyDll.dll x64; native UI cursor ABI

question: Does this Steam binary expose a concrete Scaleform hardware-mouse route with a proved receiver adjustment, integer ABI and downstream cursor consumer?
claim: Yes. The constructor installs a hardware-mouse secondary interface at CFlashUI+8, whose slot +8 calls 0x2CFCC0 and subtracts 8 before primary dispatch 0x2CEF30. Native code constructs cursor events, translates viewport coordinates, routes to eligible movies and retains the pressed receiver for release. Input-device selection is a separate listener; native mouse key 0x10A is named maxis_x. The source adds guarded main-thread delivery and quad/cylinder ray mapping; this receipt proves the static contract, not live menu acceptance.
method: Ghidra 12.1.2 explicit /Prey/PreyDll.dll. Producer constructor and downstream dispatch decompiles, plus Python 3.14 standard-library PE verifier: python verify_static.py <Steam PreyDll.dll>. Verifier requires the exact SHA-256, PE32+ AMD64, six concrete vtable targets and callback prologue. Source snapshot 05 is built with MSVC 19.50/CMake; CTest records 33 passes including independent analytic cylinder targets, transformed rooms, canted frusta and held-button state cases.

identity.reason: Ghidra metadata and read-only PE hash/base/width match the selected Steam binary.

instrument.reason: Native constructor and consumer decompiles agree with six independently read concrete slots and exact guarded bytes; no runtime observation is used for this static claim.

control.reason: PE verifier rejects a mismatched target; pure fixtures reject invalid geometry/back faces and held-entry presses, while analytic off-centre rays reconstruct their prescribed UV coordinates.

scene.reason: This receipt is restricted to static binary/source and offline tests. Separate game runs do not upgrade it.

restore.reason: Read-only target inspection and persistent source/build changes; no game-memory mutation belongs to this static receipt.

baseline.reason: Source snapshot 05 compiles and passes 33/33 offline tests. This baseline excludes native-game, compositor and headset acceptance.

limits: Static native ABI and bounded geometry/state fixtures only. PostInputEvent returning does not establish active device mode or a selected UI item. Automatic mouse mode, inventory dragging, physical comfort and terminal interaction require their own live evidence. A separate in-world examination-reticle path is documented but not hooked.
